gaps.sentence: She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ influenza, or flu, is highly contagious.
gaps.explanation: Most disease names take no article: influenza, flu, malaria (compare: the flu is also heard informally).

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
It was such ___ awful weather that we stayed indoors.
gaps.explanation: Uncountable nouns take no article after 'such': such awful weather.

gaps.sentence: We reached ___ agreement after hours of negotiation.
gaps.explanation: 'Reach an agreement' — 'agreement' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.
